classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. PDF 42 explicitly defines Q as the rational numbers; PDF 44 defines closed intervals as including both endpoints; PDF 49 defines intersection.

content.prompt: Describe, in words, the set $[0,3]\cap\mathbb Q$.

answer.short: All rational numbers between 0 and 3 inclusive.
answer.worked: The closed interval $[0,3]$ contains all real numbers from 0 to 3, including both endpoints. Intersecting it with $\mathbb Q$ retains all rational numbers between 0 and 3 inclusive.
